targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(order_total) as revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date::date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT DATE(order_date) as day, COUNT(*) as orders FROM orders WHERE order_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT p.title, SUM(oi.quantity) as units FROM order_items oi JOIN channel_listings cl ON oi.channel_listing_id = cl.id JOIN products p ON cl.product_id = p.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
